note: Researched supplier sets for the Compare tab, one per speciality. HUMAN-CURATED — no automation writes this file. Until 05/08/2026 these lived hard-coded inside app/comptab.js, which meant adding a speciality was a code change to a file that also holds the tab's rendering; there were two, and eleven specialities carried notices. Moving them here makes growth a data edit that verify.py can gate. app/comptab.js still holds vascular and continence as a baked fallback so the tab is never empty if this file cannot be fetched; anything here overrides it.
sourceRule: Every framework name, its dates and its supplier list come from that framework's own contract launch brief on supplychain.nhs.uk, fetched directly. Brand names come from the NHS Supply Chain online catalogue entry for the supplier's own NPC codes — the procurement record, not the supplier's marketing. Nothing here is inferred from a trade summary or a comparison table.

bloodcoll.label: Blood collection / phlebotomy

route.name: NHS Supply Chain — Blood Collection Devices (1 lot, 19 suppliers, 9 of them new)

bloodcoll.routeNote: One lot covering the whole category. It replaced and combined the former Blood Collection Systems and Blood Lancets framework and the Blood Culture Collection Systems framework, so a trust's incumbent may sit on it under a different arrangement than the one they remember. Blood collection is nested under Vascular access in the Hub's speciality list because the same accounts touch both — but the buyer is usually pathology or phlebotomy, not the vascular access team.

suppliers.note: Incumbent across most of the category. KFK036, its multi-sampling adaptor, is on Protect Demand Management — see live issues.
KFK232 Luer multisampling adaptor and the Vacuette Quickshield safety tube holder (450230). Named in ICN 3385 as an alternative to BD's KFK036.

Not a like-for-like swap: Sarstedt's own page describes S-Monovette drawing by aspiration ("the plunger rod is gently pulled") as well as by vacuum, so moving to it changes technique and training, not just a code. Holds four of the seven codes in the adaptor section (KCM096, KCM114, KCM128, FNG85313).
FNG85289 multi-sampling Luer adaptor holder, named in ICN 3385 as an alternative; also the SOL-CARE single-use safety tube holder (BCA019).
KFK978 sampling Luer adaptor, named in ICN 3385 as an alternative, plus the Prosum sterile sampling cap holder (BCH002).
Awarded on the framework; lancets and capillary sampling rather than venous tubes.
One of the nine suppliers new to this framework at the 2025 award.
Awarded on the framework; also on both vascular access frameworks, so often already a known name in the account.

cardiology.label: Cardiology

route.name: NHS Supply Chain — Electrodes, Ultrasound Gels, Defibrillation and Related Consumables (9 lots, 37 suppliers). Lot 8 is Defibrillation Electrodes and Pads

cardiology.routeNote: Nine lots: ultrasound gels, adult ECG electrodes, paediatric/neonatal ECG electrodes, neurology electrodes and needles, pre-wired electrodes, foetal scalp electrodes, abdominal CTG belts, defibrillation electrodes and pads, and related consumables. Defibrillation pads are Lot 8. The set below is the defibrillation and ECG electrode players, not all 37 awarded suppliers.

suppliers.note: Own-brand pads for its own defibrillators: FBH85027 adult and FBH85028 paediatric multifunction electrodes for AED Plus / R Series / X Series, FDJ1736 and FDJ1737 OneStep. The direct alternative wherever a trust runs Zoll and buys third-party pads.
Distributes Leonhard Lang's Skintact range. FDK317 and FDK049 carry an open field safety notice — see live issues. Not a recall.
Lifepak edge adult pads (FDJ3862) and defibrillation device batteries. The other large installed base alongside Zoll.
PadPro adult transparent pads with a Zoll connector (FDJ85057) — a like-for-like route for a Zoll fleet.
Distributes Telic. The widest connector coverage on the catalogue — separate codes for Zoll-M&B, Schiller, Philips/HP, Physio-Control/Medtronic-Mindray and GE fits, adult and paediatric.
Awarded on the framework; strongest in ECG electrodes.
Own-brand pads for its own defibrillator estate.
Awarded on the framework; contract manufacturer as well as own-brand, so often behind another label.
Own-brand consumables for its own monitoring and defibrillator estate.
